item.text: {"chapter_reviews":[{"attribution_risk":"high","bias_review":{"allegations_vs_findings":"Mostly separated: enforcement counts and removals are described as administrative or institutional outputs, and PAPI/PCI measure reported experience or perception rather than proved corruption prevalence. The linkage of removals to COVID-era scandals should remain institutional/official framing unless supported by case-level findings; neither enforcement volume nor surveys establishes Trọng's personal causal responsibility.","closed_system_silence":"Material residual risk. Censorship and self-censorship can conceal elite misconduct, selective enforcement, bureaucratic chilling, and internal personnel deliberation. Independent PAPI and PCI reduce silence risk for citizen and firm experience, but not for party-state internal conduct.","duplicate_reporting":"Material overlap requires deterministic consolidation: WD004 is a World Bank landing-page version of the underlying report captured more precisely in WEB-8B-C1-006; WD006 and WD008 derive from the same Viet Nam News report; WEB-8B-C1-007/008 are separate claims from one PAPI report; WEB-8B-C1-009/010 are separate claims from one PCI report; and several government/VNA portal records are one state-reporting family. Do not count these as independent corroboration merely because they have separate records.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both were performed. Favorable formal-program, enforcement, disbursement, and recovery material is paired with World Bank implementation limits, PAPI local-corruption deterioration, and PCI implementation and informal-payment findings. The search remains thin for independent adverse evidence on personnel selection and internal coercive effects.","missing_source_type":"Primary Party personnel and appointment records that identify selection ownership and rationale, plus independent Vietnamese-language institutional scholarship or audit/case-level material on appointment competence and the administrative effects of enforcement.","official_claim_independence":"Official claims are independently checked for macroeconomic recovery and implementation through the IMF and World Bank, and for local governance/anti-corruption experience through PAPI and PCI. Official enforcement counts, committee formation, individual directives, removals, and fiscal-close figures remain only partly independently checked.","open_system_complaint_volume":"PAPI and PCI report perceptions and respondent experiences, not verified prevalence; complaint/report volume may amplify highly visible problems, while a closed political system may also suppress reporting. Their mixed findings should not be converted mechanically into severity or causal findings.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"Addressed with limits: PAPI supplies nationally representative citizen coverage and PCI firm exposure; practical and collective authority are explicitly distinguished; inherited one-party institutions, 13th-Congress plans, low 2021 base, reopening, supply disruption, war, inflation, and external demand are recognized. use the underlying World Bank report in WEB-8B-C1-006 instead and exclude the gateway-only copy from evidence counts.","WD010 relies partly on a search extract and lacks a sufficiently precise locator; recover the exact GDP passage or retain only the independently corroborated World Bank treatment.","The notebook contains several state-reporting records that must be treated as one dependent official source family, not independent confirmation.","WEB-8B-C1-001 is discovery-only with blocked direct retrieval and cannot support an attribution conclusion until its precise source passage is recovered.","The chapter's strongest remaining gap is recoverable: the notebook itself identifies primary personnel records, audits, and Vietnamese-language institutional scholarship likely to improve 8B.4 and parts of 8B.8/8B.10."]}],"global_findings":["The notebook has substantial, mixed target-period evidence and meaningful independent outcome checks, but its remaining attribution and source-quality gaps are material and bounded.","No score, scoring anchor, ranking recommendation, or judge instruction is present.","Only chapter 8B is in the immutable selected scope;
